title: Lists, sets and maps in depth

objectives.text: Predict the contents and encounter order after given add and put calls on a named implementation (ArrayList, HashSet, LinkedHashSet, TreeSet, HashMap, LinkedHashMap or TreeMap), treating duplicate elements, a duplicate map key (which replaces the value) and duplicate map values (which are kept) separately

Use List, Set and Map methods (add, remove, contains, get, put, getOrDefault, entrySet) on a small data set, and remove elements during iteration with Iterator.remove or removeIf instead of a for-each loop that can throw ConcurrentModificationException
Explain why a collection made with List.of, Set.of or Map.of throws UnsupportedOperationException when modified and rejects null elements

minutes.basis: intake planning estimate under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md (budget at least ceil(max(estimator P50, modeledWorstPath)), 15-minute ceiling, no day-pool shares). Planned page: a core page with a predict-first explanation, worked example and two to three graded interactive units. modeledP50 9 is the planned estimator P50 and modeledWorstPath 12 the planned worst required route (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit); no artifact.html exists yet, so the collections-in-depth module PR re-measures both with the frozen authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py on the authored bytes and raises budget and aboutLabel if the measured minimum is higher. See authoring/evidence/collections-streams/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
